food_items.name: Nawabi Hyderabadi Mutton Dum Biryani
food_items.description: Layered aged basmati rice with tender marinated mutton chunks, saffron milk, fried onions, and cooked over wood embers on dum.

food_items.name: Andhra Special Kodi Kura (Chicken Curry)
food_items.description: Tender country chicken slow-cooked with stone-ground Guntur red chillies, poppy seeds (Gasa Gasaalu), and fresh curry leaves.

food_items.name: Gongura Mutton Curry
food_items.description: Iconic Andhra sour-spicy curry made with fresh red-stem gongura (sorrel leaves), tender goat meat, and crushed red chillies in sesame oil.

food_items.name: Telangana Bagara Rice with Natukodi Pulusu
food_items.description: Aromatic whole-spice tempered bagara rice paired with rich country-chicken (Natukodi) simmered in a robust peppery shallot gravy.

food_items.name: Gutti Vankaya Kura (Stuffed Brinjal)
food_items.description: Baby purple brinjals stuffed with roasted peanut, sesame seeds, dry coconut, and tamarind paste, simmered gently in rich spiced gravy.

food_items.name: Nellore Chepala Pulusu (Fish Curry)
food_items.description: Fresh Korameenu (Murrel fish) cooked in tangy aged tamarind gravy with fenugreek, green chillies, and clay-pot seasoning.

food_items.name: Andhra Tomato Pappu with Desi Ghee Tadka
food_items.description: Thick toor dal cooked with ripe country tomatoes, green chillies, and finished with sizzling desi ghee, garlic, and mustard seeds.

food_items.name: Temple Style Pulihora (Tamarind Rice)
food_items.description: Authentic temple prasadam tamarind rice spiced with roasted crunchy peanuts, curry leaves, ginger juliennes, green chillies, and mustard.

food_items.name: Guntur Mirchi Bajji with Stuffed Onion Masala
food_items.description: Plump Bhavnagri chillies dipped in spiced chickpea batter, golden fried, slit open and stuffed with seasoned diced onions, cilantro, and lemon.

food_items.name: Crispy Hot Punugulu with Spicy Chutney
food_items.description: Golden deep-fried batter dumplings made of fermented rice & urad dal with crushed peppercorns and onions, served with red tomato-peanut chutney.

food_items.name: Bezawada Boneless Chicken Biryani
food_items.description: Spiced tender chicken fry pieces tossed in green chilli masala layered over spiced basmati biryani rice with boiled egg & raita.

food_items.name: Pesarattu with Allam Pachadi (2 Pcs)
food_items.description: Whole green gram crisp crepe topped with finely chopped onions, ginger, and green chillies, accompanied by tangy home-style allam pachadi.

food_items.name: Steamed Button Ghee Podi Idli
food_items.description: Fluffy mini button idlis tossed generously in pure cow ghee and freshly pounded Gunpowder (Kandi Podi & Nalla Karam).

food_items.name: Karivepaku Kodi Vepudu (Curry Leaf Chicken Fry)
food_items.description: Dry roasted chicken chunks tossed with aromatic roasted fresh curry leaves powder, black pepper, and crushed garlic.

food_items.name: Authentic Gongura Pachadi (Jar)
food_items.description: Stone-ground authentic Andhra Gongura chutney preserved with garlic, roasted red chillies, and cold-pressed mustard oil.

food_items.name: Nethi Bobbatlu (Puran Poli with Desi Ghee)
food_items.description: Thin delicate sweet flatbreads stuffed with sweetened chana dal & organic jaggery, drenched in golden melted ghee.

food_items.name: Bellam Majjiga (Spiced Buttermilk)
food_items.description: Churned cooling curd blended with crushed ginger, green chillies, curry leaves, roasted cumin, and black salt.

reviews.comment: Pure authentic flavor! Reminds me of traditional old-city wedding feasts. Meat was melt-in-mouth tender and the aroma of saffron on dum was outstanding.
reviews.reply: Dhanyavadalu Dr. Prabhakar garu! We slow-cook our mutton biryani over wood embers using aged Seeraga/Basmati rice.

reviews.comment: The Gongura mutton had that quintessential sour-spicy punch from freshly plucked sorrel leaves. Goes perfectly with steamed rice and ghee.
The country chicken gravy had the exact Warangal village taste. Country chicken cooked to perfection with rustic whole spices.
Godavari style prawns with fresh coconut and poppy seed paste. Truly mouth-watering.
reviews.reply: Thank you Venkat garu! We source fresh Godavari water prawns daily.

reviews.comment: Best Gutti Vankaya in Hyderabad! The sesame, peanut, and coriander seed stuffing inside small purple brinjals was heavenly.
